messages:
lina-privops: Heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC refactor I noticed a user report that their onprem admin role couldn't decrypt customer KMS keys.
rahul-sre: @lina-privops can you paste the error they saw? :eyes: 
lina-privops: From the control plane logs: `access denied: kms:Decrypt` when controlplane tried to fetch key from customer KMS during model startup.
anna-security: Do we have audit logs for the request? I want the IAM principal that attempted access.
lina-privops: Checked CloudAudit, saw the request but principal shows `private-controlplane@redwood` and role is `onprem-admin`.
cj-oncall: That role shouldn't have `kms:Decrypt` on customer-managed keys — was scope narrowed in the RBAC refactor?
rahul-sre: We removed wildcard on `kms:Decrypt` and introduced two roles: `controlplane-kms` and `onprem-admin` — maybe mapping broke for Dedicated.
lina-privops: Repro steps I ran locally:
```
# simulate control plane fetch
curl -X POST https://private-controlplane.local/_fetch_key -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
# result: 403 kms:Decrypt
```
anna-security: @rahul-sre can you check the role-binding in the Dedicated tenant namespace? Might be missing `controlplane-kms` clusterrolebinding.
rahul-sre: Looking now. `kubectl get clusterrolebinding | grep controlplane-kms` returns nothing for tenant `esp-44`.
rahul-sre: Found the terraform change — in the refactor we generalized bindings but missed Dedicated tenants. Opening PR to add per-tenant binding.
cj-oncall: For mitigation, can we apply a temporary least-privilege binding to restore decrypt ability? We should update audit to flag missing KMS events.
lina-privops: I'm applying a scoped binding to `private-controlplane` principal in esp-44 now.
lina-privops: Applied patch: `kubectl create clusterrolebinding esp-44-controlplane-kms --clusterrole=controlplane-kms --user=private-controlplane@redwood` — will report back.
kms-bot: AuditLog: 1853456798 - KMS Decrypt succeeded for esp-44 by private-controlplane@redwood (request_id=kr_9f3)
lina-privops: Confirmed decrypt succeeded and customer reported model started up fine. :tada: 
anna-security: Good. Postmortem items: (1) add unit test / CI gate to catch missing tenant bindings, (2) enhance audit alert to detect `kms:Decrypt` 403 followed by role-binding add, (3) document the refactor mapping for Dedicated vs Hosted.
rahul-sre: I'll include a terraform plan check that verifies clusterrolebindings per tenant. PR: r/3456
cj-oncall: Add a brief incident note in incidents channel and tag affected customer — @anna-security can you review communication?
anna-security: On it. Will draft a short explanation and next steps. Also recommend a one-week review for similar RBAC mappings.
lina-privops: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the patch link and terraform guardrail in ~2 hours.
